status_legend.integrated: downloaded, inspected, prepared and used for training/evaluation in this repository
status_legend.script_only: metadata verified at the source; download/ingest script provided; not downloaded in the build environment (host blocked)
status_legend.documented_only: investigated; not ingested (licence, access or task mismatch) - reason given
status_legend.unverified: source could not be reached to verify licence/content; listed for completeness only

datasets.name: Multi-species Fruit Flower Detection (apple, peach, pear)
datasets.citation: Dias, Tabb & Medeiros (2018) IEEE RA-L 3(4):3003-3010; data DOI 10.15482/USDA.ADC/1423466
datasets.task_support: semantic segmentation (binary masks); instance boxes derived from mask components
datasets.annotation_format: PNG binary masks; per-image JSON/CSV boxes (see audit)
issues: Upstream per-image boxes are inconsistently oriented (often vertically flipped) relative to images/masks - excluded; GT boxes re-derived from masks.
117 images (mostly upstream apple 'train') have no annotations and are excluded rather than treated as negatives.
Only the foreground tree is labelled; background blossoms are unlabelled.
Species is confounded with camera setup.

datasets.name: TensorFlow Flower Detection Dataset (INESC TEC)
datasets.citation: Pinheiro, Aguiar, Figueiredo, Pinho, Valente & Santos (2023), Zenodo v1
datasets.species: images from the TensorFlow 'flowers' collection; class list not stated on the record - script reports it
datasets.notes: Close-up flower photos; complements the orchard-scene USDA data for a future YOLO11 run.

datasets.name: Oxford 102 Category Flower Dataset
datasets.license: terms not verified (site disallows automated access); treat as research-use only
datasets.task_support: image classification only (no boxes) - usable as species reference gallery, NOT as detector training data
datasets.species: 102 classes incl. sunflower and hibiscus (class indices must be verified with the script's contact sheet)

datasets.name: FlowerNet: A Multi-Class Flower Image Dataset
datasets.citation: Wahid, Islam, Tabib & Liza (2025), Mendeley Data v2, doi:10.17632/26nvt3t27m.2
datasets.leakage_warning: 5,600 of 7,000 images are augmented copies - ingest ORIGINALS only, otherwise augmented twins leak across splits.

datasets.name: Eindhoven Wildflower Dataset (EWD)
datasets.citation: Schouten, Michielsen & Gravendeel (2024) PLOS ONE 19(9), doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0302958
datasets.reason: Non-commercial licence and none of the nine target crops; useful for methodology (tiling, annotation rules), not ingested.

datasets.name: DoPI - Database of Pollinator Interactions
datasets.license: no formal licence; 'copyright restrictions: none', citation requested
datasets.reason: Great Britain only; not representative of Indian field conditions for the target crops. Importer planned for knowledge-base enrichment with explicit geographic caveat.

datasets.name: FloPE synthetic pose data
datasets.license: not stated on the abstract page
datasets.reason: No public dataset download located for this project; method informs our image-space pose module only.

datasets.name: PlantCLEF (LifeCLEF)
datasets.license: unverified (site unreachable from the build environment); historically registration + challenge terms
datasets.reason: Could not verify current terms; very large; not needed for nine crops.

datasets.name: Anther / stigma / pollen annotated images for the 9 target crops
datasets.reason: No openly licensed, reachable dataset with anther/stigma annotations for these crops was found. A CVAT annotation workflow is provided (datasets/annotation/).

datasets.name: Tomato / strawberry flower detection sets on Roboflow Universe, 4TU (Rob2Pheno) and Hugging Face
datasets.license: varies per project - must be checked individually
datasets.reason: Hosts unreachable from the build environment; licences not verified. Candidates for future ingestion via the generic YOLO ingest script.
